topics.title: What is Photosynthesis?

explanation_plan.wan_prompt: Educational animation showing a green plant leaf with sunlight rays hitting it. Visualize chlorophyll molecules in the leaf absorbing light energy. Show carbon dioxide molecules entering through stomata pores and water molecules being absorbed by roots. The animation should clearly demonstrate the concept of plants using sunlight to create food.

topics.narration: Photosynthesis is the amazing process by which green plants use sunlight to make their own food. The green pigment called chlorophyll in plant leaves captures energy from sunlight. Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air and water from the soil, and convert them into glucose, which is their food.

segments.text: Photosynthesis is the amazing process by which green plants use sunlight to make their own food.

topics.title: The Chemical Equation
topics.narration: The chemical equation of photosynthesis is very important. Six molecules of carbon dioxide react with six molecules of water in the presence of light energy. This produces one molecule of glucose and six molecules of oxygen. The glucose is stored as food, and oxygen is released into the air.

topics.title: Importance of Photosynthesis

explanation_plan.wan_prompt: Educational visualization showing the importance of photosynthesis for life on Earth. Show oxygen molecules being released from plants into the atmosphere. Visualize a food chain starting from plants to herbivores to carnivores. Include imagery of Earth's atmosphere and how plants help maintain the balance of gases.

topics.narration: Photosynthesis is essential for all life on Earth. It produces the oxygen that we breathe every day. Plants form the base of almost all food chains on our planet. Without photosynthesis, there would be no food or oxygen for animals and humans to survive.
